parser_contract.first_sentence: text.split('.')[0] if '.' occurs; ASCII full stop only
parser_contract.commas: remove all ASCII commas in the retained first sentence
parser_contract.tokenization: split(' '), without strip, lower, or generic whitespace splitting
parser_contract.otherwise: yes, including empty and malformed answers

validity_contract.strict_valid_binary: After Python str.strip(), the complete answer must be ASCII yes or no (case insensitive), optionally followed immediately by exactly one ASCII period, comma, exclamation mark, or question mark. No other text, internal whitespace, or punctuation is allowed. This diagnostic never changes the official prediction or denominator.
validity_contract.invalid_rate_denominator: all supplied records, without exclusion or remapping
validity_contract.f1: 2*TP/(2*TP+FP+FN); zero if errors exist, None if denominator is zero
validity_contract.undefined_ratio: None plus explicit zero_denominator flags; no epsilon smoothing

first_yesno_contract.invalid_accuracy_denominator: all questions; invalid first answer scores zero
first_yesno_contract.primary_metric: unchanged pinned official parser, including all invalid answers
